title: Paul McCartney live: Zentralstadion, Leipzig | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Zentralstadion in Leipzig, Germany, on 4 June 2004.

It was the fifth show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
